The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Sikkim University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.cus.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Sikkim University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Sikkim University Recruitment 2026 is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced for the posts of Research Associate, Research Assistant, and Field Investigator in the Sikkim University Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Field Investigator post is a Post Graduate Degree or a Degree in Social Sciences.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for Sikkim University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for Sikkim University Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary for all the posts (Research Associate, Research Assistant, Field Investigator) will be as per the ICSSR project guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The interview for the selected candidates is scheduled to be held on 01st October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Sikkim University located?
faq.answer: Sikkim University is located in Gangtok, Sikkim, with the pincode 737102.

faq.question: Q9. Are NET/SLET/PhD qualifications mandatory for Research Associate and Research Assistant?
faq.answer: While a Post Graduate Degree in Social Sciences with minimum 55% is required, NET/SLET/PhD are preferred qualifications for Research Associate and Research Assistant, not mandatory.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is offline only. You need to download the application form and submit it by post.
